ideas.name: Regime Radar: 2-state hidden Markov model on Bitcoin's daily returns (long bull / short bear)
ideas.source: Wang, Lin & Mikhelson, JRFM 13(12) 311 (2020) https://www.mdpi.com/1911-8074/13/12/311 ; Koki, Leonardos & Piliouras, RIBAF 59 (2022) https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.03741
ideas.rule: Quarterly expanding-window Baum-Welch fit of a 2-state Gaussian HMM on BTC daily log returns since 2010; bull = higher-mean state; hold (2p-1) x BTC perp daily.
ideas.verdict: Rejected before trading: fitted states are volatility regimes with positive means in every state (2-state 58%/yr @40% vol vs 166%/yr @165% vol; 3-4 states too, also on data to 2022) - no bear state, so the rule collapses to volatility timing (already rejected).

ideas.name: Halving Clock: long Bitcoin from the clock's bottom to its top, out for the bear year (1.5x) - Strategy 45
ideas.source: Josh Molnar, 'Bitcoin Runs on a Clock: Why Every Price Indicator Dies and the Halving Clock Doesn't', arXiv 2607.26188 / SSRN 6977940 (2026) - https://ideas.repec.org/p/arx/papers/2607.26188.html
ideas.rule: Calendar only: clock top = halving + 535 days, clock bottom = top + 379 days; daily 00:00 UTC hold the BTC perp at 1.5x equity outside [top, bottom), nothing inside; kill 90%.
ideas.verdict: Net Sharpe 1.57 (CI 0.98..2.16) vs 1.07 holding BTC, 125%/yr DD 72% at 1x 2013-2026 (182%/yr, DD 91.5% at the live 1.5x); walk-forward 2019-26 1.19 vs 0.77; calendar placebo p 0.0005; +/-60d shifts 1.40-1.46 - in-sample lags and only four cycles; opened long (clock bear year ended 2026-10-21).

ideas.name: Cross-coin return predictability, daily (rule A)
ideas.source: Guo, Sang, Tu & Wang, 'Cross-cryptocurrency return predictability', J. Economic Dynamics and Control 163 (2024) 104863 - https://research-information.bris.ac.uk/en/publications/cross-cryptocurrency-return-predictability/
ideas.rule: Daily: for each coin, 21 rolling-365d OLS of next-day return on each other coin's return, mean forecast; long top third / short bottom third, 0.5x per leg, hold 1 day.
ideas.verdict: Rejected on costs: gross Sharpe 0.65 but net -0.01 (CI -0.84..0.84) Mar 2021-Nov 2026, 15%/yr costs at 0.52 turnover/day, x3 costs -1.25.

ideas.name: Cross Wires: forecast each coin from the other coins' last week (1x, probation) - Strategy 49
ideas.source: Guo, Sang, Tu & Wang, 'Cross-cryptocurrency return predictability', J. Economic Dynamics and Control 163 (2024) 104863 - https://research-information.bris.ac.uk/en/publications/cross-cryptocurrency-return-predictability/
ideas.rule: Mondays 00:00 UTC: for each coin, 21 OLS (365d, non-overlapping weeks) of next-week return on each other coin's last-week return, mean forecast; long top third / short bottom third, 0.5x per leg, held a week; 1x, kill 40%.
ideas.verdict: Probation (nothing passed today): net Sharpe 0.07 (CI -0.63..0.87), -1.3%/yr, DD 30% at 1x Mar 2021-Nov 2026; placebo p 0.35; walk-forward -0.09; growth curve peaks below 1x so no leverage.

ideas.name: Round Numbers: trade the direction of crossings through round price levels (Osler stop-loss cascades)
ideas.source: Osler, 'Currency Orders and Exchange Rate Dynamics', Journal of Finance 58(5) 2003 - https://doi.org/10.1111/1540-6261.00594; Urquhart, 'Price clustering in Bitcoin', Economics Letters 2017 - https://doi.org/10.1016/j.econlet.2017.07.035
ideas.rule: Grid step 10^(floor(log10 p)-1); when a completed 4h close crosses a level, hold the crossing direction 24h (vol-scaled, 22 perps); daily version holds 3 days; control = the same rule on grids shifted off the round numbers
ideas.verdict: Rejected: 4h net Sharpe -1.27 (CI -2.64..0.12), -14%/yr Jul 2024-Nov 2026 (gross 0.67 eaten by 22%/yr costs); round grids no better than shifted grids (placebo p 0.50); daily -0.30.

ideas.name: AdaptiveTrend: monthly-tuned momentum + ATR trailing stops, last month's best systems, 70/30 long/short
ideas.source: Bui & Nguyen, 'AdaptiveTrend: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction', arXiv 2602.11708 (2026) - https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11708
ideas.rule: 4h bars; enter when L-bar return > theta (short < -theta), exit through alpha x ATR14 trailing stop; each month grid-search (L, theta, alpha) per coin/side on the previous month, keep longs with Sharpe >= 1.3 among the 15 most traded coins and shorts >= 1.7 among the 15 least traded; 70% long / 30% short
ideas.verdict: Rejected: did not replicate - 4h net Sharpe -0.3 (CI -1.68..1.04), -10.4%/yr, DD 45.2% Aug 2024-Nov 2026, placebo p 0.448; daily -0.11 2020-2026 with DD 89.5%; the monthly retune + Sharpe filter hurt (daily fixed-parameter control 0.64).
